blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Question answering over ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing scenes poses a tension for multimodal large language models: global overviews obscure small objects and local attributes, whereas detailed crops consume substantial context. Compressing inspected crops into short sequences of continuous visual latents offers a compact memory once crop tokens are discarded, yet diagnostic studies on natural images find that models often ignore latent content, leaving unclear whether compact latents can retain fine-grained targets lost in downsampled UHR remote sensing scenes. To isolate evidence retention from region selection, we encode high-resolution crops into latent memory tokens for frozen backbones and evaluate both their predictive utility and content dependence. Across two generations of Qwen-VL on LRS-GRO, a 64-token memory achieves 7.6- to 9.9-fold compression of retained crop tokens and improves accuracy by 2.5 to 4.8 percentage points over the downsampled global image alone, recovering most of the high-resolution crop gain with consistent behavior on XLRS-Bench. Substituting memory from another image or another region of the same scene reduces accuracy by 5.8 to 7.4 percentage points and yields lower accuracy than removing memory altogether, demonstrating that predictions depend on the encoded regional evidence. Restoring the source crop within the same model reduces the accuracy loss caused by zeroing or removing memory. These findings establish that compact visual latents retain useful local evidence in UHR remote sensing and identify evidence availability as a key factor governing their contribution.
blocks.zh: 超高分辨率遥感场面的提问回答对多式大型语言模型造成紧张:全球概览模糊了小物体和当地属性,而详细的作物消耗了大量环境。 将所检查的作物压缩成连续视觉潜伏物的短序,一旦作物标志物被丢弃,就会产生紧凑的内存,然而,对自然图像的诊断研究发现,模型往往忽略了潜伏的内容,使紧凑的潜伏物能否保留被俯冲的UHR遥感场景所损失的精细目标还不清楚。 为了将证据保留从区域选择中分离出来,我们将高分辨率作物编码为被冻结的骨干的潜在记忆符号并评价其预测效用和内容依赖性。 在LRS-GRO上的两代Quen-VL中,64位存储器对所保留的作物标志物进行了7.6-9.9倍的压缩,使仅被下取样的全球图像的精度提高了2.5-4.8个百分点,通过XLRS-Bench上一致的行为恢复了大部分高分辨率作物收益. 取而代之的是同一场景的另一个图像或另一个区域的内存,将精度降低5.8至7.4个百分点并产生比完全去除内存更低的精度,表明预测依赖于编码的区域证据. 在同一型号内恢复源收成会减少由去除或去除内存而导致的精度损失. 这些结论确定,紧凑的可视性潜力在UHR遥感中保留了有益的当地证据,并确定证据的提供是决定其贡献的关键因素。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Ultra-High-Resolution (UHR) Earth observation scenes routinely contain hundreds of millions of pixels, with small objects and fine-grained spatial relationships distributed across vast geographic areas. When multimodal large language models (MLLMs) process a downsampled global overview of such a scene, small targets and local attributes often become indistinguishable. Recent UHR remote sensing methods address this limitation through active perception and selective zooming, inspecting high-resolution crops of task-relevant regions. However, retaining the visual tokens of each inspected crop consumes substantial context budget, creating a bottleneck when reasoning over fine-grained details under limited token capacity [ 13 , 18 ] . Compressing an observed crop into a small set of continuous visual latents [ 11 , 20 , 6 , 21 ] and discarding its original tokens offers a natural mechanism for compact visual memory in UHR remote sensing.
blocks.zh: 超高分辨率(UHR)地球观测场景通常包含数亿像素,小物体和细微的空间关系分布在广阔的地理区域. 当多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)处理这种场景的俯冲全球概览时,小的目标和局部属性往往变得无法区分. 最近的UHR遥感方法通过主动感知和选择性放大、检查与任务有关的区域的高分辨率作物来解决这一局限性。 然而,保留每个被检查作物的可视标志消耗了大量的上下文预算,在有限的标志能力下对精细细节进行推理时造成瓶颈[13、18]。 将观测到的作物压缩成一小组连续的视觉潜质[11,20,6,21]并丢弃其原始的代币,为UHR遥感中的紧凑视觉记忆提供了自然机制.

blocks.en: Whether MLLMs genuinely read visual evidence stored in such compact latents, however, remains uncertain. Diagnostic studies of latent visual reasoning in general vision domains have shown that replacing latent tokens with uninformative vectors or altering their visual content often has little effect on prediction accuracy [ 7 , 12 , 17 ] . Such observations indicate that accuracy gains associated with a latent pathway do not necessarily arise from the visual information it carries. At the same time, they point to a key structural distinction between general domain images and UHR remote sensing: evidence availability, defined as whether the task-relevant information carried by a latent can also be recovered from other inputs in the context. When a global image preserves sufficient visual cues, the model retains an alternative route to the answer, consistent with findings that masking input evidence increases reliance on latents [ 17 ] . In UHR remote sensing, downsampling the global scene removes fine-grained local details, leaving compact memory as the sole retained source of zoomed-in visual evidence once crop tokens are discarded.
blocks.zh: 然而,MLLMs是否真正读取了储存在这种紧凑的潜伏物中的视觉证据仍然不确定。 对一般视觉领域潜在视觉推理的诊断研究表明,用非信息载体取代潜在信号或改变其视觉内容往往对预测准确性影响不大[7、12、17]。 这种观察表明,与潜在路径有关的准确性提高不一定来自所携带的视觉信息。 同时,它们也指出了一般域图象与UHR遥感之间的关键结构区别:证据的可得性,定义为潜伏物携带的与任务有关的信息是否可以从上下文中的其他投入中回收。 当一个全球图像保留了足够的视觉提示时,该模型保留了答案的替代路径,这与掩盖输入证据会增加对潜伏的依赖性的结论一致 [17]. 在UHR遥感中,俯冲全球场景可以移除细微的当地细节,一旦作物标志物被丢弃,紧凑的内存就成为唯一留存的放大视觉证据来源.

blocks.en: We investigate whether this natural evidence scarcity enables compact visual latents to serve as an effective, content-dependent memory for UHR question answering. To separate the retention and reading of local evidence from the choice of where to look, we fix crop locations using region annotations (Figure 1 ). Keeping both the vision encoder and the language model frozen, we first calibrate a shared 8-token format prefix on global overviews to absorb answer formatting and label priors across all evaluated conditions, and then train only a lightweight resampler [ 10 , 1 ] of approximately 10M parameters to map each high-resolution crop into K K latent memory tokens. At inference, original crop tokens are removed, and the frozen model answers from the question, the downsampled global image, the shared format prefix, and the K K memory tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们调查这种自然证据的缺乏是否使紧凑的视觉潜质成为有效、依赖内容的UHR问题回答记忆。 为了将当地证据的保留和阅读与选择在哪里寻找区分开来,我们使用区域说明(图1)固定作物位置。 保持视觉编码器和语言模型的冻结,我们首先在全局概览上校准一个共享的8个托肯格式前缀,以吸收在所有评估条件下的答案格式化和标签前缀,然后只训练一个大约10M参数的轻量级复标器[10,1],将每个高分辨的裁剪映射到K潜伏内存符号中. 推论中,原作物符被移除,被冻结的模型从问题中解答,下图全局图像,共享格式前缀,以及K K内存符.

blocks.en: Across two generations of Qwen-VL [ 3 , 2 ] on the local questions of LRS-GRO [ 13 ] , compact visual memory delivers substantial context savings alongside consistent accuracy gains. With K = 64 K=64 memory tokens, accuracy improves by 2.5 percentage points on Qwen2.5-VL and 4.8 percentage points on Qwen3-VL relative to using only the downsampled global image. This representation replaces full-resolution crop encodings averaging 634 and 486 tokens, achieving 9.9-fold and 7.6-fold compression of retained crop context while recovering approximately two thirds of the full-crop gain on Qwen2.5-VL and matching full-crop accuracy on Qwen3-VL. It also outperforms matched-budget alternatives on LRS-GRO and transfers directly on Qwen3-VL to XLRS-Bench [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 关于LRS-GRO的当地问题,在两代的Quen-VL[3,2]中,紧凑的视觉记忆在不断提高准确度的同时,可以产生大量的上下文节省。 使用K = 64 K = 64 内存符号,精度在Quen2.5-VL上提高了2.5个百分点,在Quen3-VL上提高了4.8个百分点,仅使用下采样的全球图像. 这种表示取代了平均634和486令牌的全分辨率作物编码,实现了保留作物背景的9.9倍和7.6倍的压缩,同时恢复了Quen2.5-VL上全作物收益的约三分之二,并在Quen3-VL上匹配全作物精度. 它还在LRS-GRO上超越了相应的预算替代品,并在Qune3-VL上直接转移到XLRS-Bench [19].

blocks.en: Targeted interventions on the memory further establish that predictions depend on the specific regional evidence it encodes, and that this dependence varies with evidence availability. Holding token count, token positions, and model weights fixed, substituting memory from another image reduces accuracy by 7.4 percentage points on Qwen2.5-VL and 6.2 percentage points on Qwen3-VL, while substituting memory from another annotated region of the same scene reduces accuracy by 6.0 and 5.8 percentage points, respectively. In both models, mismatched memory yields lower accuracy than removing the memory altogether, confirming that the model actively reads the retained local content. Restoring the source crop to the context within the same trained model reduces the accuracy loss caused by zeroing or removing memory by 2.7 to 3.3 percentage points on LRS-GRO, with even larger reductions on XLRS-Bench. Thus, the contribution of the same visual latent shifts according to whether its local evidence is accessible elsewhere in the context.
blocks.zh: 有针对性的记忆干预进一步确定,预测取决于它编码的具体区域证据,这种依赖性随证据的可得性而异. 持有令牌计数,令牌位置,以及固定的模型权重,取代另一个图像的内存,将Quen2.5-VL的精度降低7.4个百分点,将Quen3-VL的精度降低6.2个百分点,同时将来自同一场景另一个附加注释区域的内存分别降低6.0和5.8个百分点. 在两种模型中,不匹配的内存产生比完全去除内存更低的精度,证实模型积极读取保留的地方内容. 在同一经过训练的模型内将源作物恢复到上下文,使LRS-GRO上因零化或去除内存而导致的精度损失降低2.7至3.3个百分点,XLRS-Bench上的减幅更大. 因此,视其当地证据能否在其他地方查阅而定,同一视觉潜在变化的贡献。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We demonstrate that compact visual latents efficiently retain fine-grained local evidence in UHR remote sensing. Across Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3-VL on LRS-GRO, a 64-token memory achieves 7.6-fold to 9.9-fold compression of retained crop tokens, improves accuracy by 2.5 to 4.8 percentage points over the global image alone, and recovers most or all of the high-resolution crop gain, with consistent cross-dataset transfer on Qwen3-VL to XLRS-Bench. • We establish causal dependence on encoded regional content through controlled substitutions and matched-budget baselines. Replacing memory with latents from another image or another region within the same UHR scene reduces accuracy by 5.8 to 7.4 percentage points and harms prediction more than removing memory altogether. • We identify evidence availability as a key factor governing visual latent reliance in MLLMs. Restoring the source crop within the same model substantially attenuates the accuracy loss of zeroing or removing memory, explaining why the loss of fine detail in downsampled UHR overviews activates latent memory use.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们证明,紧凑的视觉潜力在UHR遥感中有效地保留了精细的当地证据。 在LRS-GRO上的Quen2.5-VL和Quen3-VL上,64位存储器实现了对保留作物标志物的7.6倍至9.9倍的压缩,将准确度提高2.5至4.8个百分点,高于全球图像,恢复了大部分或所有高分辨率作物收益,在Quen3-VL上一致的跨数据集传输到XLRS-Bench. ^ 我们通过控制下的替代和相应的预算基线,确定对编码区域内容的因果关系。 用来自同一UHR场景内另一图像或另一区域的潜伏物来取代内存将精度降低5.8至7.4个百分点,伤害预测大于完全去除内存. 我们确定,证据的可得性是MLLMs中视觉潜在依赖的一个关键因素。 在同一模型中恢复源作物,大大减轻了零化或去除内存的准确性损失,解释了为什么在下取样的UHR概览中失去精细细节会激活潜在的内存使用。

Across Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3-VL on LRS-GRO, a 64-token memory achieves 7.6-fold to 9.9-fold compression of retained crop tokens, improves accuracy by 2.5 to 4.8 percentage points over the global image alone, and recovers most or all of the high-resolution crop gain, with consistent cross-dataset transfer on Qwen3-VL to XLRS-Bench.

blocks.en: UHR remote sensing requires models to interpret small objects and local attributes distributed across large scenes. Benchmarks such as XLRS-Bench [ 19 ] and LRS-VQA [ 14 ] highlight the difficulty of preserving subtle local details under constrained visual processing budgets. Existing methods improve access to relevant regions through selective processing. Luo et al. [ 14 ] combine a dynamic image pyramid with tile selection guided by text and token pruning, while ZoomEarth [ 13 ] and Wang et al. [ 18 ] employ adaptive cropping, zooming, and visual tools to acquire local visual evidence. Whereas these approaches focus on selecting where to inspect a scene, retaining the visual tokens of inspected crops still consumes substantial context. Our work complements region selection by demonstrating that acquired local evidence remains useful when compressed into compact visual latents after the original crop tokens are discarded.
blocks.zh: UHR遥感需要模型来解释分布在大场景的小物体和局部属性. XLRS-Bench[19]和LRS-VQA[14]等基准凸显了在受限的视觉处理预算下保存微妙的本地细节的困难. 现有方法通过有选择的处理改善进入相关区域的机会。 罗等. [14] 结合了动态图像金字塔和以文字和信使普鲁恩为指南的瓦片选择,而ZoomEarth [13]和Wang et al. [18] 利用适应性的作物栽培,放大,以及视觉工具来获取当地视觉证据. 虽然这些办法侧重于选择检查场景的地点,但保留所检查作物的视觉标志仍然消耗大量环境。 我们的工作是对区域选择的补充,它表明,当原始作物标志丢弃后压缩成紧凑的视觉潜质时,获得的当地证据仍然有用。

blocks.en: Visual token compression produces compact representations of visual inputs to reduce computational and context costs. Perceiver [ 10 ] aggregates dense inputs into a latent array, while Flamingo [ 1 ] uses a Perceiver Resampler to produce a fixed number of visual tokens. Token Merging [ 4 ] combines similar tokens in vision transformers, and FastV [ 5 ] prunes redundant visual tokens within multimodal language models. Related work on visual memory, including MA-LMM [ 8 ] and MovieChat [ 16 ] , retains information from earlier frames to support the understanding of long videos. In our setting, a resampler with learned queries encodes crops at high resolution into compact latent memories. Beyond evaluating accuracy under reduced token budgets, we examine whether model predictions genuinely depend on the regional visual information preserved in these tokens.
blocks.zh: 视觉符号压缩产生视觉输入的紧凑表示,以减少计算和上下文成本. Perceiver [10] 将密集的输入集合到一个潜伏的阵列中,而Flamingo [1] 则使用一个Perceiver Resampler来生成一个固定数量的视觉符号. Token Menging [4] 结合了视觉变压器中的类似符号,FastV [5] 在多模式语言模型中翻转了多余的视觉符号. 关于视觉记忆的相关作品,包括MA-LMM [8]和电影 聊天 [16],保留早先帧的信息,以支持对长视频的理解. 在我们的环境下,一个有学问的复刻器 将高分辨率的作物编码成紧凑的潜在记忆 除了在减少的象征性预算下评估准确性外,我们还审查模型预测是否真正依赖于这些符号中保存的区域视觉信息。

blocks.en: Latent visual reasoning introduces continuous tokens as intermediate visual representations within multimodal language models [ 11 , 6 , 21 ] . Methods such as Monet [ 20 ] train models to generate these representations through visual supervision and distillation to support reasoning in latent space. Alongside advances in latent construction, diagnostic studies have examined whether model predictions depend on the visual content of these representations. Li et al. [ 12 ] identify weak connections between input images, latent representations, and final predictions in evaluated models. Guo et al. [ 7 ] distinguish the content of latent slots from boundary markers and formatting, showing that substantial performance gains can persist without the slot content. Viveiros et al. [ 17 ] connect latent bypass to visual evidence already accessible in the input and demonstrate increased reliance when relevant image regions are masked during training. CVRR [ 15 ] makes the recurrent latent state the required visual pathway for prediction and shows that restoring an alternative visual route partially compensates for corrupted latent content. These findings indicate that the contribution of visual latents depends on both their encoded content and the surrounding visual context. Extending this perspective to UHR remote sensing, we show that compact latent memories preserve local details obscured in the downsampled global overview and that model predictions rely on this regional content. Furthermore, restoring the source crop within the same model reduces reliance on memory, supporting evidence availability as an explanation for the contribution of visual latents.
blocks.zh: Latett视觉推理引入连续符号作为多式联运模型中的中间视觉表现[11,6,21]. Monet [20] 等方法通过视觉监督和衍射来训练模型来生成这些表达,以支持潜在空间中的推理. 除了潜在构造的进展外,诊断研究还审查了模型预测是否取决于这些表示的视觉内容。 李等编. [12] 查明输入图像、潜在表示和被评价模型中的最后预测之间的薄弱联系。 郭等编. [7] 将潜在插槽的内容与边界标记和格式化区分开来,表明没有插槽内容,大量性能收益可以持续. 维维罗斯等人. [17] 将潜在绕行与输入中已经可获取的视觉证据连接起来,并表明在培训过程中掩盖相关图像区域时的依赖度增加。 CVRR [15] 使反复出现的潜在状态成为预测所需的视觉路径,并表明恢复替代视觉路径部分地补偿了腐败的潜在内容. 这些调查结果表明,视觉潜伏物的贡献取决于其编码内容和周围视觉背景. 将这一视角延伸至UHR遥感,我们表明,紧凑的潜在记忆保留了被俯瞰的全球概览所掩盖的地方细节,模型预测依赖于这一区域内容。 此外,在同一模型内恢复源作物可减少对内存的依赖,支持证据的可用性,作为视觉潜伏作用的解释。

blocks.en: 3 Visual Memory Testbed and Protocol
blocks.zh: 3 视觉内存测试台和协议

blocks.en: To evaluate whether compact visual latents preserve useful local evidence in UHR remote sensing, we construct a controlled question answering testbed. This section details the memory construction pipeline, the two context conditions and causal interventions used to probe content reliance, and the evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 为了评价紧凑的视觉潜力是否保留了UHR遥感中有用的当地证据,我们构建了一个可控问题回答测试床。 本节详细介绍了内存构建管道,用于探究内容依赖性的两个上下文条件和因果干预措施,以及评价协议.

blocks.en: 3.1 Compact Crop Memory Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 压缩作物记忆建设

blocks.en: Given a question q q about a UHR scene, the model receives a downsampled global image resized to a maximum side length of 1,024 pixels. Although this overview preserves global scene layout, small targets and local attributes often become indistinguishable at this scale. To supply fine local detail while separating memory retention from region localization, we extract a crop from the annotated region associated with each question. Following the LRS-GRO implementation [ 13 ] , we enlarge the annotated bounding box by 50%, enforce a minimum side length of 512 pixels at native resolution, and resize the crop so that its longer side does not exceed 1,024 pixels.
blocks.zh: 考虑到一个关于UHR场景的Q q问题,该模型接收到一个被下取样的全局图像调整大小,最大侧长为1,024像素. 虽然这一概述保留了全局场景布局,但小的目标和局部属性往往在这个尺度上变得无法区分. 为了提供精细的当地细节,同时将内存保留与区域本地化区分开来,我们从每个问题相关的注释区域提取一个作物. 在LRS-GRO执行[13]之后,我们将附加说明的边框扩大50%,在原生分辨率下执行512像素的最低边长,并调整作物的大小,使其更长的边长不超过1,024像素.

blocks.en: The frozen vision encoder maps the crop to a sequence of visual features, which are compressed into a memory m m of K K continuous tokens in the embedding space of the language model (Figure 1 ). Our resampler [ 10 , 1 ] consists of 2 layers with internal dimension 512, 8 attention heads, feedforward width 2,048, and 64 learned queries; for any budget K ∈ { 4 , 8 , 16 , 32 , 64 } K\in\{4,8,16,32,64\} ( K = 64 K=64 by default), it selects the first K K queries. Each layer applies cross attention from the queries to the crop features followed by a feedforward network, projecting back to the hidden dimension of the language model (3,584 on Qwen2.5-VL, totaling 10.0M trainable parameters). Its output projection is initialized to zero and added as a residual to spatially pooled crop features, so the module reduces exactly to the Average Pooling baseline before training.
blocks.zh: 冷冻的视觉编码器将裁剪映射为一系列视觉特征,这些特征在语言模型的嵌入空间(图1)中被压缩成一个存储器m m of K K 连续符. 我们的复刻器 [10, 1] 由2层组成,内部尺寸512,8个注意头,向导宽度2,048和64个学到的查询;对于任何预算 K {{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{}K\{{{{} K\in 4,8,16,32,64}(K=64 K=64 K=64 默认情况下的查询)),它选择第一个 K K K K 查询. 每层将查询中的交叉注意力应用到作物特征上,然后是feedforward网络,投射回语言模型的隐藏维度(Qwen2.5-VL上为3,584,共10.0M可列车参数). 其产出预测初始化为零,并作为空间集成的作物特征的剩余部分而增加,因此该模块在培训前完全减少到平均集成基线。

blocks.en: Throughout training, both the vision encoder and the language model remain strictly frozen without LoRA [ 9 ] or backbone tuning. Using 2,117 local training questions from 228 scenes and 223 validation questions from 54 scenes in LRS-GRO, we run two stages with AdamW, batch size 1 with 8 gradient accumulation steps, gradient clipping at 1.0, and a constant learning rate without warmup. To prevent trained memory from winning merely by adapting output formatting or answer priors on a frozen backbone, Stage 1 initializes an 8-token format prefix (28.7K parameters on Qwen2.5-VL and 32.8K on Qwen3-VL) from the first 8 token embeddings of “Answer with a short lowercase phrase and no punctuation.” and trains it for 3 epochs at a learning rate of 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} with zero weight decay using answer cross entropy on global overviews and questions alone, selecting the checkpoint with lowest validation cross entropy. This 8-token format prefix is then frozen and inserted after the visual or memory tokens and before the question in every evaluated condition and intervention. Stage 2 updates only the resampler (10.0M parameters on Qwen2.5-VL and 10.5M on Qwen3-VL) for 4 epochs at a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} with weight decay 0.01, minimizing answer cross entropy combined with a counterfactual margin loss and logit distillation over the top 64 tokens from uncompressed crop inputs.
blocks.zh: 在整个训练中,视觉编码器和语言模型都保持严格冻结,没有LORA[9]或主干调. 使用来自228场景的2117个局部训练问题和来自LRS-GRO54场景的223个验证问题,我们与AdamW一起运行了两个阶段,第1批尺寸有8梯度积分步骤,梯度剪切速度为1.0,持续学习速率不热. 为了防止训练有素的内存仅通过在冻结的主干上调整输出格式或回答前缀而获得胜利,第一阶段从“Answer with a short case parameter and no punctuation”的前8个符号嵌入“Answer with a short class parameter and no punctuation”中初始化了一个8个托肯格式前缀(Quen2.5-VL上的28.7K参数和Qwen3-VL上的32.8K参数),并以3×10−4 3\times 10^{-4}的学习速率为3个纪元进行训练,仅使用全球概览和问题上的回答交叉entropy值衰减为零,选择了最低验证交叉entropy的检查站。 这个8键格式的前缀随后被冻结,并插入到视觉或记忆符号之后,以及每个评估条件和干预中的问题之前. 第2阶段仅更新了4个纪元的复刻器(Quen2.5-VL上的10.0M参数和Quen3-VL上的10.5M参数),学习速度为1×10−4 1\times 10^{-4},重量衰减0.01,最小化了答题交叉 en,结合了反事实差值损失和对未压缩的作物投入在前64个符号上的登录衍射.

blocks.en: 3.2 Diagnostic Contexts and Interventions
blocks.zh: 3.2 诊断背景和干预

blocks.en: Let c c denote the answering context accompanying the memory m m . We distinguish overall predictive utility from causal reliance on memory content. Predictive utility is measured by comparing accuracy against a baseline that receives only the question and the downsampled global overview. Reliance is measured within the same trained model by intervening on m m while holding c c and all model weights fixed. For an intervention that replaces m m with m ~ \tilde{m} , we define paired reliance in percentage points on identical questions as: Rel = Acc c , m − Acc c , m ~ . \mathrm{Rel}=\mathrm{Acc}_{c,\,m}-\mathrm{Acc}_{c,\,\tilde{m}}. (1) A positive value of Rel \mathrm{Rel} indicates that corrupting or removing the memory reduces prediction accuracy.
blocks.zh: 让 c 表示内存 m 的响应上下文 。 我们把总体预测效用与因果依赖内存内容区分开来. 衡量预测效用的方法是,将准确性与只收到问题的基准和下取样的全球概览进行比较。 依赖度是在同一个训练有素的模型内测量的,在持有c和所有模型重量固定的同时,在m米上进行干预。 对于将 m 替换为 m ~\ tilde{ m} 的干预,我们对相同问题的成对依赖百分点定义为: Rel = Acc c, m – Acc c, m ~ \ mathrm{ Rel}=\ mathrm{ Acc}_{c,\, m} -\ mathrm{ Acc}_{c,\,\ tilde{ m} 。 (1)Rel\mathrm{Rel}的正值表明,损坏或移除内存会降低预测的准确性.

blocks.en: Evidence availability refers to whether the local information carried by m m can also be recovered from the surrounding context c c . We evaluate how evidence availability shapes memory reliance by comparing two answering contexts at inference time (Figure 1 ): • Scarce context (Remembering). Original crop tokens are discarded, so c c contains only the question and the downsampled global overview. Because the model cannot inspect the crop pixels again, m m serves as the sole retained carrier of zoomed local evidence. • Redundant context (Looking again). Original crop tokens from which m m was written are restored to c c alongside the same memory m m . Because the zoomed evidence is simultaneously accessible as pixels, comparing reliance across the two contexts while keeping model weights, questions, and memories fixed isolates the effect of evidence availability within a single model, providing an inference counterpart to the masked training analysis of Viveiros et al . [ 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 证据的可得性是指m m所携带的本地信息是否也可以从周围的上下文c c 中找到. 我们评价证据的可用性如何通过比较推论时间的两个解答背景(图1)来决定内存的依赖性: • 稀缺背景(回忆). 原作物令牌被丢弃,因此cc只包含问题和下标的全球概览. 由于模型无法再次检查作物像素, m m 成为当地放大证据的唯一保留载体. • 冗余背景(再看一次)。 原作物符号,其中m m 的写法与同一内存m m 一起恢复为c c. 因为放大的证据作为像素可以同时获取,比较了两种背景的依赖性,同时将模型权重,问题和记忆固定在单个模型中隔离出证据可用性的效果,为维威罗斯等人的蒙面训练分析提供了推论对应. [17].

blocks.en: We apply four targeted interventions to m m . Zero replaces every memory token with a zero vector, and Drop removes the memory tokens from the input sequence; together they test whether the retained pathway contributes necessary information. Swap-Image replaces m m with memory encoded from a different scene, whereas Swap-Region replaces m m with memory encoded from another annotated region within the same scene. Because Swap-Image and Swap-Region preserve the exact number, sequence positions, and feature distribution of the memory tokens as well as the trained pathway that consumes them, they isolate dependence on regional visual content from potential artifacts caused by sequence truncation.
blocks.zh: 我们针对 m. 0用零向量取代每个内存符号,Drop从输入序列中去除内存符号;它们一起测试保留路径是否贡献了必要的信息. 交换-图像用不同场景编码的内存替换m m,而交换-区域则用同一场景内另一个注解区域编码的内存替换m m. 由于Swap-Image和Swap-Region保留了记忆符的确切数量,序列位置和特征分布以及消耗它们经过训练的路径,它们将区域视觉内容的依赖性与序列断裂导致的潜在文物隔离开来.

blocks.en: 3.3 Benchmarks, Controls, and Scoring Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.3 基准、控制和计分议定书

blocks.en: We conduct our primary evaluation on LRS-GRO [ 13 ] , covering 7,393 local test questions across 839 UHR scenes using Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct [ 3 ] and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 2 ] , which tokenize visual inputs at 28 and 32 pixels per token, respectively. To test generalization across datasets, we evaluate the Qwen3-VL model trained on LRS-GRO directly without further training on 1,657 questions with reference boxes from 856 scenes in XLRS-Bench [ 19 ] , denoted XLRS-Bench-lite, applying the identical crop extraction rule to each reference box.
blocks.zh: 我们对 LRS-GRO [13] 进行初步评价,涵盖839 UHR场景的7,393个局部测试问题,使用Qun2.5-VL-7B-指示[3]和Qun3-VL-8B-指示[2],分别以每像素28和32像素表示视觉输入。 为了测试跨数据集的通用化,我们直接评价在LRS-GRO上接受训练的Qune3-VL模型,而无需在1,657个问题上接受进一步培训,其参考框来自XLRS-Bench [19]中的856场景,表示XLRS-Bench-lite,将相同的作物提取规则应用于每个参考框.

blocks.en: All evaluated conditions share the frozen backbone, question, downsampled global overview, and frozen 8-token Stage 1 format prefix. Thumbnail , High-Res Crop , Low-Res Pixels , Average Pooling , and Text Notes introduce zero additional trainable parameters beyond this shared prefix: Thumbnail provides no crop, High-Res Crop supplies uncompressed crop tokens, and the three compact baselines at budget K K compress the crop via image downsampling, spatial feature pooling (the exact zero-parameter initialization of Memory ), or truncated descriptions generated by the frozen backbone without the prefix (at most K K tokens). Soft Prompt places K K static learned vectors independent of the crop at the memory token positions using answer cross entropy; because it has far fewer parameters than the resampler, it tests adding K K learned continuous slots without crop input, whereas full resampler parameter capacity is controlled in Section 4.2 via Zero and Swap-Image using the identical Stage 2 checkpoint. Across tables, reported token counts measure only the regional evidence payload per question, excluding the global overview, the shared 8-token format prefix, and region label text.
blocks.zh: 所有被评价的条件都共享被冻结的骨干,质疑,下取样的全球概览,以及被冻结的8-token阶段1格式前缀. 缩略图 , 高Res crop , 低Res像素, 平均集合, 和文本 Notes , 在这个共享的前缀之外引入零额外可列车参数 : 缩略图不提供作物,High-Res Crop供应未压缩的作物标志,预算K的三个紧凑基线通过图像下取样,空间特征集合(记忆的精确零参数初始化),或冷冻骨干生成的没有前缀的短写描述(大多数K标志)来压缩作物. 软速将K K 静态学习向量独立于在内存符号位置上的收录器,使用答案交叉 en;因为它的参数远少于复刻器,所以它测试在不收录作物输入的情况下添加K K 已学习的连续插槽,而完整的复刻器参数能力则通过零和交换-图像控制在第4.2节,使用相同的阶段2检查点. 在整个表格中,所报告的符号计数只衡量每个问题的区域证据有效载荷,不包括全球概览、共享的8个托肯格式前缀和区域标签文本。

blocks.en: All runs use greedy decoding under a fixed generation configuration and share a deterministic scoring protocol. When a question specifies candidate answers, we score the likelihood assigned to each candidate rather than parsing generated text; otherwise, we apply official benchmark matching rules. Likelihood scoring prevents output formatting failures from confounding memory interventions: in a pilot on XLRS-Bench using generative extraction, Zero lowered accuracy by 19.8 percentage points largely through invalid output formats. All comparisons are paired on identical test questions, which remain strictly excluded from model development and checkpoint selection. We report 95% confidence intervals from a cluster bootstrap over scenes to account for correlation among questions sharing the same scene, considering an intervention effect statistically supported when the lower bound of its 95% confidence interval exceeds zero.
blocks.zh: 所有运行在固定生成配置下都使用贪婪的解码,并共享一个决定性的评分协议. 当一个问题指定了候选人的答案时,我们得分是分配给每个候选人的可能性,而不是分析生成的文本;否则,我们适用官方基准匹配规则。 偏好评分防止输出格式化失败使内存干预混乱:在使用基因提取法的XLRS-Bench实验中,Zero主要通过无效输出格式将精度降低19.8个百分点. 所有比较都是在相同的测试问题上配对的,这些测试问题仍然被严格排除在模型开发和检查站选择之外。 我们报告95%的置信间隔 从一个群集的靴子在场景上, 来说明共享同一场景的问题之间的关联性, 考虑到在95%置信间隔的下限超过零时,

blocks.en: 4 Empirical Findings
blocks.zh: 4 经验调查结果

blocks.en: We organize our empirical analysis around three progressive questions: whether compact visual memory preserves fine local details under tight token budgets, whether predictions genuinely depend on the regional visual content stored in memory, and why UHR remote sensing activates latent reading where general vision settings often exhibit bypass. Unless stated otherwise, results use the default budget of K = 64 K=64 tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们围绕三个进步问题组织我们的经验分析:紧凑的视觉记忆是否在紧凑的符号预算下保存了精细的局部细节,预测是否真正依赖于存储在记忆中的区域视觉内容,以及UHR遥感为何激活了潜伏的阅读,而一般视觉环境往往显示绕行. 除非另有说明,结果使用默认预算K=64K=64令牌.

blocks.en: Table 1 evaluates predictive utility and retained context cost when original crop tokens are discarded. On LRS-GRO, adding K = 64 K=64 latent memory tokens raises accuracy over Thumbnail from 54.6% to 57.1% (+2.5 percentage points) on Qwen2.5-VL and from 57.2% to 62.0% (+4.8 percentage points) on Qwen3-VL. These 64 tokens replace full crop representations averaging 634 tokens on Qwen2.5-VL and 486 tokens on Qwen3-VL, compressing retained crop context by factors of 9.9 and 7.6, respectively. Despite this compression, Memory recovers roughly two thirds of the full crop improvement on Qwen2.5-VL (57.1% vs. 58.4%) and matches High-Res Crop on Qwen3-VL (62.0% vs. 61.6%, a paired difference of 0.4 ​ [ − 0.4 , 1.2 ] 0.4\;[-0.4,\,1.2] points). When transferred directly to XLRS-Bench-lite without additional training, Memory on Qwen3-VL improves accuracy over Thumbnail by 12.2 percentage points (from 36.3% to 48.5%), preserving approximately 70% of the High-Res Crop gain while compressing an average of 321.8 crop tokens by a factor of 5.0.

blocks.en: Comparisons against controls at matched budgets confirm that these improvements cannot be explained by adding static learned token slots without crop input. Soft Prompt yields 53.8% on Qwen2.5-VL and 57.7% on Qwen3-VL on LRS-GRO, and 37.5% on XLRS-Bench-lite, remaining near Thumbnail across all settings (while Section 4.2 rules out the 10.0M to 10.5M resampler parameters by evaluating the identical checkpoint under Zero and Swap-Image ).
blocks.zh: 与相应预算的控制进行比较后确认,这些改进不能通过在没有作物投入的情况下添加静态的已学习符号槽来解释。 软速率在Quen2.5-VL和在LRS-GRO的Quen3-VL和在XLRS-Bench-lite上分别获得53.8%和57.7%的产量,在各种场合都保持在Thumbnail附近(而第4.2节通过评价零和Swap-Image下的相同检查站而排除了10.0M至10.5M的重装参数)。

blocks.en: To verify that accuracy gains arise from reading visual information stored in memory rather than from structural formatting cues, Table 2 measures paired reliance under targeted interventions in the scarce context. Eliminating memory information consistently degrades performance: on LRS-GRO, Zero lowers accuracy by 4.5 ​ [ 3.6 , 5.3 ] 4.5\;[3.6,\,5.3] percentage points on Qwen2.5-VL and 5.2 ​ [ 4.4 , 6.0 ] 5.2\;[4.4,\,6.0] points on Qwen3-VL, while Drop reduces accuracy by 3.5 ​ [ 2.6 , 4.4 ] 3.5\;[2.6,\,4.4] and 4.6 ​ [ 3.9 , 5.4 ] 4.6\;[3.9,\,5.4] points, respectively. On XLRS-Bench-lite, both Zero and Drop reduce Qwen3-VL accuracy by 11.8 percentage points, returning performance to the level of Thumbnail alone (36.6% to 36.7% vs. 36.3%).

blocks.en: Content substitutions provide a stricter test by preserving token count, sequence positions, and latent distributions within the identical trained model while altering only the encoded region. Replacing memory with latents from another scene ( Swap-Image ) reduces accuracy by 7.4 ​ [ 6.5 , 8.3 ] 7.4\;[6.5,\,8.3] points on Qwen2.5-VL and 6.2 ​ [ 5.4 , 7.0 ] 6.2\;[5.4,\,7.0] points on Qwen3-VL on LRS-GRO, and by 16.1 ​ [ 13.5 , 18.7 ] 16.1\;[13.5,\,18.7] points on XLRS-Bench-lite. Even when global scene context is shared, replacing memory with latents from another annotated region of the same UHR image ( Swap-Region ) lowers accuracy by 6.0 ​ [ 4.9 , 7.1 ] 6.0\;[4.9,\,7.1] and 5.8 ​ [ 4.9 , 6.7 ] 5.8\;[4.9,\,6.7] points on LRS-GRO, and by 16.3 ​ [ 13.5 , 19.3 ] 16.3\;[13.5,\,19.3] points on XLRS-Bench-lite. Across every model and dataset, both Swap-Image and Swap-Region produce lower accuracy than removing memory altogether ( Drop ), pushing predictions below the Thumbnail baseline. Incorrect regional latents actively mislead the model, demonstrating that predictions rely on the specific local visual evidence encoded in memory.
blocks.zh: 内容替换提供了一个更严格的检验标准,在相同的训练有素的模型中保留符号计数、序列位置和潜在分布,同时只改变编码区域。 用另一个场景(换乘-图像)的潜伏物取代记忆,将精度降低7.4 [6.5, 8.3] 7.4\;[6.5,\,8.3]在Qun2.5-VL和6.2[5.4,7.0] 6.2\;[5.4,\,7.0]在LRS-GRO的Qun3-VL和16.1 [13.5,18.7] 16.1\;[13.5,\,18.7]在XLRS-Bench-lite上的积分. 即使全球场景背景共享,用同一UHR图像(Swap-Region )的另一个注解区域(swap-Region )的潜伏物取代内存,精确度降低为6.0 [4.9,7.1] 6.0\;[4.9,\ 7.1]和5.8 [4.9,6.7] 5.8\;[4.9,\,6.7] LRS-GRO上的积分,以16.3 [13.5,19.3] 16.3\;[13.5,\19.3] xLRS-Bench-lite上的积分. 在所有模型和数据集中,交换图像和交换区域所产生的准确度都低于完全去除内存(Drop ),从而将预测推到缩略图基线以下。 不正确的区域潜质积极误导模型,表明预测依赖于存储器中编码的具体的局部视觉证据.

blocks.en: Model predictions causally depend on the regional visual content of latent memory: substituting latents from another image or another region within the same UHR scene degrades accuracy even more than removing memory altogether.
blocks.zh: 模型预测因果地依赖于潜在内存的区域视觉内容:取代同一UHR场景内另一个图像或另一个区域的潜在,比完全去除内存更能降低精度.

blocks.en: The strong content sensitivity observed above contrasts sharply with diagnostic findings in general vision domains. As summarized in Table 3 , substituting latents from another image or injecting uninformative tokens on standard visual benchmarks typically alters accuracy by at most two to four percentage points [ 17 ] , and donor latents from the same image rarely steer model predictions [ 7 ] . In our scarce UHR setting, analogous interventions consistently induce drops of 4.5 to 7.4 percentage points on LRS-GRO and up to 16.3 points on XLRS-Bench-lite. Unlike natural images where global views often retain sufficient cues to answer local queries, downsampling a UHR Earth observation scene removes small targets and subtle attributes, leaving compact memory as the only carrier of local visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 上文观察到的强烈内容敏感性与一般视觉领域的诊断结论形成鲜明对比。 如表3所概述,将另一种图像的潜伏物或注入非成像符号替换在标准视觉基准上,通常会改变准确度,最高为2至4个百分点[17],而同一图像的捐赠者潜伏物很少指导模型预测[7]。 在我们稀少的UHR环境中,类似的干预措施一直导致LRS-GRO下降4.5至7.4个百分点,XLRS-Bench-lite下降16.3个百分点。 与常保留足够提示以回答本地询问的自然图像不同,对UHR地球观测场景进行下取样可以消除小目标和微妙属性,留下紧凑的内存作为本地视觉证据的唯一载体.

blocks.en: To test whether evidence availability directly governs this behavior within the same model, we restore the source crop tokens alongside the memory at inference time (the redundant context) while keeping all model weights, questions, global overviews, and memories unchanged (Table 4 ). On LRS-GRO, restoring the crop reduces accuracy loss under Zero by 3.2 ​ [ 2.4 , 4.1 ] 3.2\;[2.4,\,4.1] percentage points on Qwen2.5-VL and 2.7 ​ [ 2.0 , 3.5 ] 2.7\;[2.0,\,3.5] points on Qwen3-VL, and reduces loss under Drop by 3.3 ​ [ 2.4 , 4.2 ] 3.3\;[2.4,\,4.2] and 2.9 ​ [ 2.1 , 3.8 ] 2.9\;[2.1,\,3.8] points, respectively. On XLRS-Bench-lite, restoring the source crop on Qwen3-VL reduces reliance under Zero and Drop by 14.9 ​ [ 12.2 , 17.6 ] 14.9\;[12.2,\,17.6] and 19.0 ​ [ 16.3 , 21.7 ] 19.0\;[16.3,\,21.7] percentage points; in this redundant setting, removing the transferred memory ( Drop ) raises accuracy by 7.2 points. Providing direct pixel access to the local region thus supplies an alternative route to the visual evidence and substantially lowers the cost of zeroing or removing memory.
blocks.zh: 为了测试证据的可用性是否直接支配同一模型内的行为,我们在推论时间(冗余上下文)与内存同时恢复源作物符号,同时保持所有模型的权重,问题,全局概览和记忆不变(表4). 在LRS-GRO上,恢复作物将零下的精度损失降低3.2 [2.4, 4.1] 3.2\;[2.4,\,4.1]在Qun2.5-VL和2.7 [2.0,3.5] 2.7\;[2.0,\,3.5]在Qun3-VL上降低精度损失,并将下降损失分别降低3.3 [2.4,4.2] 3.3\;[2.4,\,4.2]和2.9 [2.1,3.8] 2.9\;[2.1,\,3.8] 点。 在XLRS-Bench-lite上,恢复Qune3-VL的原产地作物将零下的依赖性降低14.9[12.2,17.6]14.9\;[12.2,\,17.6]和19.0[16.3,21.7]19.0\;[16.3,\,21.7]百分点;在这种冗余设置中,去掉转移的内存(Drop)提高了7.2分的准确度. 提供对当地地区的直接像素访问,从而提供了视觉证据的替代途径,并大大降低了零化或去除内存的成本.

blocks.en: At the same time, access to source pixels does not make the model impervious to conflicting memory content. In the redundant context on LRS-GRO, Swap-Region still lowers accuracy by 3.7 ​ [ 2.8 , 4.7 ] 3.7\;[2.8,\,4.7] points on Qwen2.5-VL and 2.1 ​ [ 1.4 , 2.8 ] 2.1\;[1.4,\,2.8] points on Qwen3-VL, while on XLRS-Bench-lite reliance under Swap-Region remains virtually unchanged at 16.1 ​ [ 13.3 , 18.9 ] 16.1\;[13.3,\,18.9] points (a reduction of 0.2 ​ [ − 2.1 , 2.7 ] 0.2\;[-2.1,\,2.7] points). Restoring source pixels therefore diminishes the necessity of memory when it is absent, while predictions remain sensitive to mismatched regional content.
blocks.zh: 同时,获取源像素并不能使模型不受相互冲突的内存内容的影响. 在LRS-GRO的冗余语境中,Swap-Region的精度仍降低3.7[2.8,4.7]3.7;[2.8,\,4.7]在Qun2.5-VL和2.1[1.4,2.8]2.1\;[1.4,\,2.8]在Qun3-VL上的精度,而XLRS-Bench-lite在Swap-Region下的依赖性几乎保持不变,为16.1[13.3,18.9]16.1\;[13.3,\,18.9]分(减少0.2[−2.1,2.7]0.2\;[-2.1,\2.7])。 因此,恢复源像素会减少记忆缺失时的必要性,而预测对不匹配的区域内容仍然敏感.

blocks.en: Evidence availability directly modulates reliance on visual latents within a single model: restoring high-resolution crop pixels substantially reduces the cost of zeroing or removing memory, explaining why natural detail loss in downsampled UHR overviews activates latent reading.
blocks.zh: 证据的可用性直接调制了单一模型内对视觉潜伏物的依赖:恢复高分辨率的作物像素会大幅降低零化或去除内存的成本,解释为什么在下取样的UHR概览中自然细节损失会激活潜伏读物.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: Our experiments establish that compact visual latents written from inspected crops serve as genuine local memory in UHR remote sensing. After original crop tokens are removed, retaining memory improves accuracy, and substituting its regional content degrades predictions across both benchmarks. Pairing predictive utility with causal content sensitivity addresses a central concern raised by Guo et al. [ 7 ] , who show that accuracy gains from latent tokens need not imply that their contents store visual information. Complementing diagnostics of latents generated as intermediate reasoning states, our results confirm a concrete memory function when latents encode observed local crops obscured in the global overview. Restoring the source crop further links this function to surrounding visual context, extending the account of Viveiros et al. [ 17 ] to retained crop representations while uncovering an operational asymmetry: access to source pixels reduces the penalty of zeroing or dropping memory, yet does not protect predictions against mismatched regional latents ( Swap-Region ), particularly on XLRS-Bench-lite (Table 4 ). For sequential remote sensing agents, deciding when to retain past crop memories and verifying their consistency with newly inspected pixels therefore represent distinct design requirements.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验证实,从所检查的作物中写成的紧凑的视觉潜伏物,是UHR遥感中真正的当地记忆。 原作物代币被移除后,保留内存会提高准确性,取代其区域内容会降低对两个基准的预测. 将预测效用与因果内容敏感性对齐解决了郭等人提出的一个中心关切问题。 [7],他们表明,从潜在信物中获得的准确性并不一定意味着其内容存储视觉信息. 作为对中间推理状态所产生的潜在物的诊断的补充,当潜在物编码观测到全球概览中模糊的地方作物时,我们的结果证实了具体的记忆功能。 恢复源作物进一步将这一功能与周围的视觉上下文联系起来,扩展了Viveiros等人的账户. [17] 保留作物表示,同时发现操作上的不对称:获取源像素可以减轻零化或下降内存的处罚,但不能保护预测避免错配的区域潜伏(Swap-Region),特别是在XLRS-Bench-lite上(表4)。 因此,对于相继的遥感剂而言,决定何时保留过去的作物记忆并核实其与新检查的象素的一致性是不同的设计要求。

blocks.en: Comparisons across datasets and question types clarify where learned query resampling is most effective. On XLRS-Bench-lite, 64 memory tokens on Qwen3-VL preserve roughly 70% of the accuracy gain provided by High-Res Crop over Thumbnail at fivefold token compression (Table 1 ) while exhibiting strong content dependence (Table 2 ). Under the same budget of 64 tokens, however, Low-Res Pixels achieves higher accuracy without relying on resampling queries learned on LRS-GRO, indicating that the relative advantage of learned compression over spatial downsampling varies under domain shift. Task granularity introduces a related distinction on LRS-GRO: although Qwen3-VL with Memory matches High-Res Crop in overall accuracy, its accuracy on object counting questions drops to 32.1% compared with 41.0% for High-Res Crop. Learned query resampling effectively condenses regional semantics and attributes into a small token budget, whereas tasks requiring discrete instance enumeration or direct transfer across imagery distributions benefit from preserving explicit spatial structure.
blocks.zh: 不同数据集的比较和问题类型澄清了哪些学到的查询重新取样最为有效. 在XLRS-Bench-lite上,Qune3-VL上的64个内存符号以5倍的符号压缩(表1)保存了高Res Crop在缩略图上提供的精度增益的约70%,同时表现出强烈的内容依赖性(表2). 然而,在64个令牌的同一预算下,低Res像素在不依赖在LRS-GRO上学到的复标查询的情况下实现了更高的精度,表明在域移下,所学压缩相对于空间下标的相对优势有所不同. 任务颗粒性在LRS-GRO上引入了相关的区别:虽然带有内存的Quen3-VL在整体准确度上与高Res Crop匹配,但其在对象计数问题的精确度下降到32.1%,而高Res Crop的精确度为41.0%. 所学的查询复标可以有效地将区域语义和属性压缩成一个小的符号预算,而需要单列实例查点或跨图像分布的直接传输的任务则得益于保留明确的空间结构。

blocks.en: Fixing crop locations through region annotations or reference boxes separates the retention and reading of local evidence from localization errors. Combining compact latent memory with learned region selection [ 13 , 18 ] to support reasoning across multiple inspected regions is a natural next step for UHR Earth observation systems. Evaluating architectures beyond two generations of the Qwen-VL family will also clarify how broadly these behaviors hold across multimodal backbones. Finally, our compression ratios measure the visual context retained within the language model; because the vision encoder still processes each crop prior to resampling, benchmarking overall inference latency remains an important direction for deployment.
blocks.zh: 通过区域说明或参考框确定作物位置,将当地证据的保留和阅读与本地化错误区分开来。 将紧凑的潜在记忆与知识型区域选择[13,18]结合起来,以支持多个被检查区域的推理,是UHR地球观测系统的下一个自然步骤。 评价超过两代的Quen-VL家族的建筑,也将澄清这些行为在多大程度上跨越了多式联运支柱。 最后,我们的压缩比衡量语言模型中保留的视觉上下文;因为视觉编码器仍然在重新取样之前处理每个作物,因此将总体推论延迟作为基准仍然是部署的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Reasoning over UHR remote sensing imagery under constrained token budgets requires preserving fine local details that disappear in downsampled global overviews without retaining hundreds of tokens per inspected crop. Across two generations of Qwen-VL on LRS-GRO and transfer evaluation on XLRS-Bench, compressing crops at high resolution into compact latent memories recovers most or all of the accuracy benefit of uncompressed crops at a fraction of their context cost. Controlled content substitutions confirm that model predictions rely on the encoded regional visual evidence rather than added token capacity, while restoring source crop pixels within the same model demonstrates that evidence availability governs reliance on memory. These findings establish compact visual latents as an effective mechanism for retaining observed local evidence in UHR remote sensing. Looking ahead, whereas current evaluations focus on individual local regions, complex Earth observation tasks often require comparing and aggregating evidence across several crops within a vast scene, where retaining uncompressed tokens quickly becomes infeasible. Extending our compact memory framework and diagnostic protocol to settings with multiple crops, together with constructing new UHR benchmarks for reasoning across multiple retained regions, represents a promising direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 由于UHR遥感图象在受限的象征性预算下存在,需要保存细微的当地细节,这些细节消失在俯瞰的全球概览中,而不保留每被检查作物数百个标志物。 在整个两代LRS-GRO上的Quen-VL和XLRS-Bench的转移评价中,以高分辨率将作物压缩成紧凑的潜在记忆,以占其上下文成本的一小部分来恢复未压缩作物的多数或全部准确性。 受控内容替代证实模型预测依赖于编码的区域视觉证据,而不是添加符号能力,而在同一模型中恢复源作物像素则表明证据可用性支配对内存的依赖. 这些结论确立了紧凑的视觉潜力,作为保留在UHR遥感中观察到的当地证据的有效机制。 展望未来,虽然目前的评价侧重于个别地区,但复杂的地球观测任务往往需要在一个广阔的场景中比较和汇总若干作物的证据,在这种场景中,保留不压缩的标志很快变得不可行。 将我们紧凑的记忆框架和诊断协议扩大到多种作物的环境,同时为多个保留区域的推理制定新的UHR基准,是未来工作的一个有希望的方向。
